transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been really struggling with staying in my seat when I'm supposed to, and I often find myself blurting out answers before people even finish speaking. It's starting to cause some issues, so I wanted to get some help with these behaviors.

In addition to those impulsive behaviors, do you also frequently struggle with tasks that require sustained attention, such as finishing projects, organizing your belongings, or avoiding careless mistakes?
No, I don't really struggle with those kinds of tasks. I'm actually pretty good at organizing my things and I don't usually make careless mistakes on my projects.
